data.title: Choose the correct answer for each question.
data.description: Practise organising short B1 texts with clear openings, sequencing, paragraph focus and conclusions.
learningPoints: Begin paragraphs with a clear main idea.
Keep supporting sentences relevant to the paragraph topic.
Use sequencing words to organise events and processes.
Use linking expressions to connect paragraphs and ideas.
Recognise logical order in short emails, stories and opinion texts.

sections.explain: A topic sentence introduces the main idea of a paragraph.

words.word: There are several advantages to learning a foreign language.
Yesterday at three o'clock I bought a blue pen.
Because however foreign languages.

sections.explain: Supporting sentences should develop the paragraph's main idea.

words.word: For example, speaking another language can make travel easier.
My neighbour has a red bicycle, which is unrelated to language learning.
However because for example travel.

sections.explain: Use FIRST, NEXT and FINALLY to show a logical order.

words.word: First, open the file. Next, make your changes. Finally, save it.
Finally, open the file. First, save it. Next, make your changes.
Because open the file, however save it, although change it.

sections.explain: A new paragraph should clearly signal its topic or relationship to the previous one.

words.word: Another important benefit is the flexibility of online study.
Blue is my favourite colour.
And but because flexibility.

sections.explain: A conclusion should summarise or close the main idea rather than introduce an unrelated topic.

words.word: Overall, the course was challenging but very useful.
My brother bought a car yesterday.
Firstly, a completely new topic begins here.

sections.explain: A narrative should usually present events in a clear time sequence.

words.word: After we arrived at the station, we bought our tickets and then boarded the train.
Then we boarded the train before we arrived at the station and bought tickets later first.
However because the station, finally before arriving.

sections.explain: A contrast paragraph should signal that a different viewpoint or disadvantage is being introduced.

words.word: On the other hand, working from home can sometimes feel isolating.
In addition, working from home is isolating as an identical advantage.
First, because however home.

sections.explain: Good organisation avoids repeating the same main idea without adding information.

words.word: Public transport reduces traffic. It can also lower air pollution in cities.
Public transport reduces traffic. Public transport reduces traffic. Public transport reduces traffic.
Traffic public because transport however.

sections.summary: Using an example after a general statement.
sections.explain: An example should directly illustrate the previous general point.

words.word: Many people use apps to practise languages. For instance, they may use vocabulary quizzes on their phones.
Many people use apps to practise languages. For instance, the moon orbits the Earth.
Many people use apps. However for instance because phones.

sections.explain: A final sentence should restate the position or summarise the argument.

words.word: For these reasons, I believe public transport should receive more investment.
My first reason will now begin in the final sentence.
Because however therefore public transport.
